Hi Lisa — attaching the model worksheet and a simple token projection CSV for your team (attachments: catalyst_model_shortlist.xlsx, token_projection.csv). Summary of the recommendation below — happy to iterate after you review.

Model shortlist (recommended order):
1) redwood-alpha-4k (quantized): production default for summarization and short QA. Good latency/cost balance; supports continuous batching and prefix caching. Context: 4k.
2) redwood-beta-8k: for full-note QA and scenarios where clinician prompts need multi-encounter context. Higher token cost but preserves accuracy on long documents. Context: 8k.
3) redwood-embed-lite: small embedding model for semantic search / reranking of candidate answers; use to reduce generator calls. Context: N/A (embeddings).

Token projection (high-level):
- Inputs per month (month 1): MAUs 1,200 * avg prompts 8 = 9,600 prompts.
- Avg input tokens (estimated): 160 tokens. Avg completion tokens (summary) 120 tokens. => avg round-trip ~280 tokens.
- Month 1 projected input+output tokens: 9,600 * 280 = 2,688,000 tokens (~2.7M).
- Month 6 projection (conservative growth x3): 8,640 prompts/month -> wait, correction: growth x3 => 28,800 prompts/month. 28,800 * 280 = 8,064,000 tokens (~8.1M).

Notes / assumptions:
- We assumed 1:1 generator calls per clinician prompt; you can reduce generator calls by doing candidate filtering with the embedding model (reduces generator volume by ~30–50% depending on rerank strategy).
- Peak concurrency: with 25 concurrent requests and average generation latency 250–450ms on redwood-alpha-4k, Dedicated x-small pool should be fine for canary. For production sizing we recommend Dedicated x-medium with autoscale policy to stay under p95=600ms at load. Aditya can add exact GPU counts based on your throughput SLA.
- Context decisions: summarization uses a sliding context window and a short-prefix cache; full-note QA should be pinned to redwood-beta-8k.

Action items I propose:
- Lisa: confirm whether you want summaries clipped to 1,500 tokens or full free-length summaries (affects completion token estimate).
- Vanessa / Aditya: provide Dedicated sizing options and a proposed MAP (I attached a one-page draft).
- Catalyst engineering: share a small sample of de-identified prompts for a quick eval run (we can run a 48–72h eval to validate token averages).

Thanks — attaching the files for your review.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
